paragraphs: A single-page portfolio built with Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript and Tailwind CSS v4, in a bold neo-brutalist style: 3px borders, hard offset shadows with zero blur, and a cream / orange-red / pastel palette. Dark mode follows the OS by default and has a manual toggle.

All content lives in typed files under src/data — nothing is hardcoded in a component. Those files are also the fallback: content can be edited at runtime through a password-protected admin panel, stored in MongoDB, and the public site falls back to src/data whenever the database is unreachable or empty. See Admin panel & database.
Every loop is a transform or opacity animation, which the compositor runs without touching layout or paint. The three decisions that keep it that way:
